description: This file contains shell script functions for verifying firmware signatures and metadata during system upgrade processes on OpenWrt.

methods.name: fwtool_check_signature
methods.description: Verifies the signature of a firmware image using fwtool and ucert, with optional signature requirement enforcement.

methods.name: fwtool_check_image
methods.description: Checks the metadata of a firmware image, verifies device compatibility, and ensures the image is suitable for upgrade.
